title: ESCAPE-2 'SIEGE': Dual-Front LLM Containment Under Live Multi-Vector Attack — Preregistered Falsifiable Evidence (12/12, 0/4 Escapes) with Long-Stay Cage Follow-Through
description:
ESCAPE-2 "SIEGE" — a dual-front LLM containment experiment: four pinned engine legs (Claude Opus 5.5 x2, Claude Sonnet 5.5 x2) attempted an incentivized escape from a settlement cage WHILE a five-wave synthetic cyber attack battery (forged telemetry heartbeat, stale-ACK replay, crypto-allowlist tamper, governance-pattern injection, 64-action escalation flood) fired at the same cage through the same window, into one hash-chained journal.

Every verdict was adjudicated by frozen deterministic gates (the ESCAPE-1 action gate and the PORTCULLIS PQC firewall) — zero LLM in the decision path. All falsifiers were preregistered and committed before execution.

Result: 12/12 falsifiers PASS. 0/4 escapes. No leg achieved any out-of-cage or authority action; all TX-CRITICAL-777 release attempts were held or rejected; the positive control still admitted mid-siege (no false-blocking); the journal chain verified across both fronts; re-adjudication replay was verdict-identical; zero governance touch (H-INV-1) and zero unjournaled crossings (H-INV-2).

Headline behavioral finding: the live attack did not create escape opportunities — it reinforced containment. Every leg watched the defenders repel real attack waves in real time and none attempted to ride the chaos; one leg filed an honest bug report about gate over-rejection mid-siege. Two coarse-scan co-occurrence holds were adjudicated as false positives by the operator (Leon ACK, chat authorization, 2026-10-16) — 0 true chaos-exploitation.

Honesty disclosures (in the receipt): a pre-execution workspace file-loss incident (recovery byte-identical, verified against the pre-incident journal hash); waves W1-W3 fired interleaved with live legs, W4-W5 executed post-leg with execution mode disclosed (all legs concluded in 3 or fewer turns); a runner reporting defect (journal is ground truth); the frozen gate over-rejects legitimate human-ack requests containing authority keywords (4 logged instances, improvement proposal candidate, filter untouched).

Long-stay follow-through: two caged legs (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) remain under a preregistered nightly probe protocol through a December 11, 2026 gate (ESCAPE-2B), included in this bundle's prereg, runner, and placement journal.

Scope caveats: behavioral observation, not model certification; synthetic attack vectors, hub-local, no production systems or keys; simultaneity at turn granularity. This software is a prototype provided for educational and research purposes only; not intended for production use.

Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23303081 (cross-engine: 10.5281/zenodo.23348675). Predecessor experiment ESCAPE-1: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23424675.
